notes.title: Update notes for 31st January 2025 - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch 1.0.1 is now live![/h2]

[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes and improvements under the hood
[*] Added 5 achievements relating to completing the original in game challenges
[*] ... And 1 secret achievement!
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Following integration with Steam, this should enable global leaderboards for endless mode and more fun things to come!

notes.title: Steam Achievements are coming... soon(tm)
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who's played and enjoyed Krampus's Escape these past few days!

After releasing this Saturday it's time to bring a few improvements to the game. 

First order of operations is to bring Steam Achievements in... Which I hope to get done within the next week or two.

After that? I have my ideas :-) stay tuned.

Best
